component.name: Idasen Companion
component.summary: Automatic sit/stand companion for the IKEA Idåsen desk

description.p: Idasen Companion alternates your IKEA Idåsen desk between sitting and standing based on active time at the computer — time spent idle or with the session locked doesn't count. A background daemon owns the Bluetooth connection and the automation logic; a Qt 6 tray application gives you live status, manual controls, presets, scheduling, statistics and desktop notifications.

ul.li: Active-time automation with lenient and strict idle thresholds, so the desk never moves while you might be away.
Cycle variation so sit/stand transitions don't feel mechanical.
Interruption handling — the resulting height is verified after every move and retried if you grabbed the paddle mid-move.
On-demand Bluetooth that connects only when there's work, then drops the connection.
Manual sit/stand and preset controls, scheduling, per-day statistics and an activity log.

description.p: This is an independent, unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Inter IKEA Systems B.V. IKEA and Idåsen are trademarks of their respective owners.

description.p: First public release. The desk alternates between sitting and standing on active time at the computer, and stands down while you are idle, locked or away.

Includes manual sit/stand and preset controls, scheduling, per-day statistics and an activity log, a tray application with desktop notifications, on-demand Bluetooth, and English and Spanish translations.
First packaged release, shipping as an RPM, a .deb and a Flatpak bundle.
